Name: Sandstorm
Effect: All characters on this tile lose 1 range (to a minimum of 1)

Name: Swap places
Effect: Swap the place of two characters
Notes: Select two characters to swap positions

Name: Call for a friend
Effect: Summon a random friendly character to a hex of your choice
Notes: Spawns copy of random friendly unit

Name: Thunderstorm
Effect: Deal 1 damage to up to 3 random characters friend or foe

Name: Berserk
Effect: Give a friendly character +1 damage and -1 health
